name: ridesync
description: RideSync — personal motorcycle trip planning and management system

scripts.db:up: docker start ridesync-pg || docker run -d --name ridesync-pg -e POSTGRES_USER=ridesync -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=ridesync -e POSTGRES_DB=ridesync -p 5455:5432 pgvector/pgvector:pg16
scripts.db:status: docker exec ridesync-pg pg_isready -U ridesync -d ridesync
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it ridesync-pg psql -U ridesync -d ridesync
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ridesync/shared && npm run test -w @ridesync/server
